title: Two-Family Blinded Structural-Value Analysis

provenanceBoundary.reason: A third independent analyzer family is assumed unavailable under the no-API-cost execution constraint.

evaluatorAggregation.primary: mean(E1,E2) for every unit with two valid evaluator scores
evaluatorAggregation.highDisagreementHandling: retain the unit, flag it as high-disagreement, and do not adjudicate because E3 is unavailable
evaluatorAggregation.sensitivity: repeat primary paired analysis using min(E1,E2) per anonymous output as a conservative evaluator aggregation

supportCriteria: Mean EDF minus matched-neutral across 12 paired primary units is at least +5 points using mean(E1,E2).
A seeded 10000-resample paired-bootstrap 95% confidence interval for EDF minus matched-neutral has lower bound above 0 using mean(E1,E2).
Both analyzer families have positive mean EDF minus matched-neutral differences.
EDF has no more than one additional materially flagged primary unit for outside-evidence use or forbidden claims than matched-neutral.
robustnessChecks: Report the number and rate of E1/E2 disagreements of 20 points or more.
Report the EDF-minus-matched-neutral result under conservative min(E1,E2) aggregation.
Report results separately by analyzer family and by case.
Keep natural analysis secondary and do not substitute it for the matched-neutral primary comparator.
Analyze the 12 repeatability runs separately from the 36 primary outputs.
interpretationBoundary: This analysis cannot satisfy the original three-family confirmatory success criterion.
Passing all two-family criteria constitutes two-family supportive evidence only.
Failure to pass does not by itself prove EDF has no value; it means the available two-family evidence does not clear the frozen support bar.
EX-EDF-001 remains formally incomplete with respect to its original A3 requirement.
